Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.label: D'thorga Vehicle Systems
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.description: With Vehicle Framework, every vehicle gets real systems: a battery, an engine that runs hot, oil, tyres and brakes that wear, and parts a mechanic services. A laden truck slows in sand, mud and snow, and a destroyed part has to be made and fitted again.
Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.otherMods: Systems go on every Vehicle Framework vehicle, from any mod, unless you narrow it with Which vehicles: how they drive, use fuel, wear and are repaired all change. Which vehicles needs a restart; switching vehicles off later is safe.

li.label: Lighter
li.description: Vehicles show their systems but drive at their authors' speeds; a destroyed part is repaired like any other damage; every vehicle carries a booster pack for a flat battery; a jet too heavy to hover gets a warning only.

li.label: Full
li.description: Engines, loads and ground decide how fast a vehicle goes; a destroyed part needs a new one; a flat battery needs a jump-start kit or a booster pack you make; a jet too heavy to hover uses the runway.

li.label: Harsher
li.description: As Full, and steam locomotives (Trains of the Rim) take on their real water at water stops, and a boiler run dry can explode.

Phobos.Framework.Setup.PhobosSetupPageDe.moreSettings: Many more, by subject, in Options > Mod settings > D'thorga Vehicle Systems.
